description:
h1. Phase 17 — My Notifications

*Business purpose:* Reliable owner-scoped notifications, preferences and audited delivery operations for patients, doctors, reception staff and platform admins.

*Endpoint:* {{GET /api/v1/notifications/mine}}
*Actor:* Patient/Doctor/Reception/SuperAdmin
*Permission:* {{Notifications.ViewOwn}}

h2. Request/parameters

Query: pageNumber=1, pageSize=20 (max100), optional category, isRead

h2. Success and response

200 NotificationPage<InboxItem> = {items,pageNumber,pageSize,totalCount}; item {id,eventType,category,title,message,createdAtUtc,readAtUtc,isRead,target}

h2. UI flow

Inbox screen: newest first, tabs All/Unread, category filters, paging, item click via server target; target is navigation-only and must recheck source access. Clinical target exposes generic MedicalRecord without source key.

h2. Shared integration, security & errors

* .NET 10 Wasla API v1; use Authorization: Bearer <token> and Accept-Language ar|en.
* Server checks live role, active account, permission, ownership/current Reception scope. Do not grant source access through an inbox item.
* Handle loading, empty, success, forbidden and retry states. HTTP 400 binding, 401 unauthenticated, 403 permission, 404 hidden/not found, 409 stale conflict, 422 validation; localized ProblemDetails errors[].code drive UI.
* No PHI/private clinical or email body in notifications UI; never fetch protected resources by guessing IDs.
* Backend implemented (Phase17); this is strictly FE integration pending; tests must include own/cross-user scope, 401/403/404, paging, retry and stale version as applicable.

h2. Acceptance criteria

* Typed Angular request/response models align with API v1 and exact method/route.
* Screen interaction follows the journey above with loading/empty/success/error states.
* Permissions/capabilities gate controls; backend authorization is authoritative.
* Actions refresh relevant lists/details/versions and handle errors without blind replay.
* ar/en UX and basic accessibility/responsive layout supported.
